content.question: What is the main difference between batch, layer, group, and instance normalization?
options: They differ in the activation functions they are compatible with.
They differ in how many epochs they require to converge.
They differ only in the order of layers they can be inserted into.
They differ in what the normalization statistics are computed over: across the mini-batch, per sample across features, within groups of channels, or per channel of each instance.
content.answer: They differ in what the normalization statistics are computed over: across the mini-batch, per sample across features, within groups of channels, or per channel of each instance.
